description_en: 2019–2020, Abuja: university students started a science club around a microscope X-WOW sent, ran lockdown microbiology lectures, and a sister club trained future vet pathologists. Who did it, and how.
description_zh: 2019–2020 年，阿布贾：大学生用 X-WOW 寄去的显微镜办起科学俱乐部，封城期间办微生物网课；姊妹俱乐部则培养过未来的兽医病理学家。谁做的，怎么做的。
